'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Micah Wall DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Micah Wall]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
